question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Microsoft Teams multi-account contract: `channels.msteams.accounts`, `channels.msteams.defaultAccount`, legacy root config as the implicit default account, named accounts with explicit identity and webhook port, and account-scoped auth/session/state?
rationale: The patch is a broad new public channel configuration and runtime contract; code review can check consistency, but only maintainers can decide whether this is the permanent Teams account model and listener shape OpenClaw should support.

options.title: Accept this contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head refresh if Teams/core owners agree that per-account credentials plus per-account listener ports are the intended public Teams model.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller contract change, such as route-based multiplexing or different account inheritance semantics, before publishing the config surface.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and close or pause this branch if maintainers do not want first-class Teams multi-account support in core/plugin surface yet.

recommendation.title: Accept this contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head refresh if Teams/core owners agree that per-account credentials plus per-account listener ports are the intended public Teams model.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible Microsoft ecosystem tracker owner and a recent Teams config/runtime contributor, and the contributor has explicitly asked them for acceptance of this Teams contract.
